"GAME SYSTEM DESIGN PROMPT: AETHERBOUND (Ultra-Condensed)
Act as an expert game developer. Build or code the core systems for \"Aetherbound: Echoes of the Rift\", a 3rd-person action-RPG with active 4-unit frontline combat (Player + 3 monsters).
Core Loop @COMMENT_BODY@ Combat
 * Loop: Explore Biomes \rightarrow Engage Monsters \rightarrow Subdue/Slay \rightarrow Harvest/Recruit \rightarrow Forge Gear \rightarrow Conquer Rifts.
 * 4 Classes: Riftwarden (Tank), Elementalist (Mage), Shadowdancer (Agile Striker), Animist (Support).
 * Bonding: Fighting together builds Sync Rate (0–100%), unlocking Unison Ultimates.
Elemental Reaction Matrix
Combine elements to trigger instant combat reactions:
 * Flame + Tide = Steam Burst: High AoE scalding damage + Blinds target (-40% accuracy).
 * Gale + Flame = Wildfire Whirlwind: Spreads Burn damage over time to adjacent foes.
 * Terra + Tide = Mudslide Quake: Roots targets + Reduces Physical Defense by 30%.
 * Terra + Gale = Dust Storm: Reduces enemy accuracy + Exposes weak points for 8s.
Capture @COMMENT_BODY@ Crafting
 * Subduing: Lower HP below 15%, inflict status effects, and channel the Aether-Snare tether (boosted by frost gear, bait, and traps).
 * Slaying: Harvest Scales, Bones, and Cores to forge monster-themed weapons and armor.
Engine Specs
INSTRUCTIONS FOR AI ENGINE:
1. Logic: Implement dynamic player/companion entity systems and an Elemental State Machine for combo triggers.
2. Capture Formula: P(Capture) = ( (1 - CurrentHP / MaxHP) * BaseCaptureRate * StatusMultiplier * ItemBonus ) / MonsterResist
3. Output: Generate JSON schemas for Classes, Monsters, Combos, and Recipes.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game for “Aetherbound: Echoes of the Rift,” implementing its frontline combat, elemental reactions, capture, crafting, and data schemas.

## Requirements
- Third-person action-RPG loop with a player and three active monster companions; four selectable classes; Sync Rate and Unison Ultimate.
- Implement four specified elemental reactions and the capture formula, plus slaying/harvesting and crafting.
- Generate JSON schemas for classes, monsters, combos, and recipes.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained HTML5 canvas game with responsive desktop/mobile controls and no build dependencies.
- Used illustrative 2D canvas art instead of external game assets; initial encounter is Brambleback in the Lumen Grove.
- Included example game data alongside its schema.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added playable combat/exploration UI, player movement, companion attacks, enemy AI, class abilities, elemental reactions, capture, crafting, and rift progression.
- Added class/party selection, forge, mobile touch controls, and keyboard controls.
- Added game data and JSON Schema files; validated both JSON files and extracted JavaScript syntax.
- Captured a screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/aetherbound.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- Playwright CLI browser capture could not run because its expected Chromium installation was missing; a screenshot was instead captured using system Chromium.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the game in a browser and fix any gameplay or UI issues found.
2. Consider improving reaction effect fidelity and content depth if needed.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete browser game implementation.
- `game-data.json`: Example classes, monsters, combos, and recipes.
- `game-data.schema.json`: JSON Schema describing the game data.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Served locally with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed with: `Browser "chromium" is not installed; expected executable at /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome. Run \`playwright-cli install-browser chromium\` to install`.
- A system-Chromium screenshot was written to `/tmp/opencode/aetherbound.jpg`.
